answer: Stop sybils with a wharf vine ledger: an agent stakes a bond for one wharf berth. Each cycle a vine grows along the wharf, linking its work; at each comet pass verifiers check it, voiding a berth whose vine is copied, broken, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 berths at 16x cost each: each vine fits one berth and one comet pass, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents berth once and keep rights.
